name: Mar Primitivo
description: a shallow primordial sea at dawn viewed from underwater, golden sunlight filtering from above, rounded stromatolite mounds, primitive algae, sponges and sparse spiral shells, turquoise water coral-pink accents and gold light
map: an overhead distant view of a shallow turquoise ancient sea with rounded reef-like stromatolite shoals, primitive algae islands and quiet open water paths

name: Bosque Gigante
description: an enormous Carboniferous swamp forest, tree-sized horsetails and giant ferns, tall scaled trunks, subtle distant green haze and a few luminous spore motes, wet green amber palette and faint distant electric-blue storm light
ground: two large broad fallen moss-covered logs with flat tops
map: an overhead distant swamp forest map with giant fern canopies, horsetail groves, winding dark water channels and broad quiet clearings

name: Jurásico
description: a wide Jurassic valley of conifers and cycads, a winding river, dormant volcanoes far away, bright green ochre and blue sky; ONLY tiny indistinct sauropod silhouettes on the remote horizon, no foreground animals
ground: two clearings of gently trampled green grass
map: an overhead distant Jurassic valley map with a looping river, conifer and cycad clusters, low dormant volcanic hills and open green paths, no animals

name: Cretácico
description: a coastal Cretaceous cliff at sunset, orange-red violet and cream sky, one small bright distant meteor high in sky (not an explosion), magnolia trees and early flowers at outer edges, distant ocean
ground: two wide flat rocky cliff ledges integrated into a continuous safe fighting shelf
map: an overhead distant sunset coastal plateau map, dark magnolia groves, cream rock cliffs, violet ocean inlets and a small subtle meteor in the far sky

name: Edad de Hielo
description: a snowy Ice Age tundra with immense pale-blue glaciers, green northern lights in a deep blue sky, snow-covered fir trees and patches of warm brown earth, luminous clean cold palette
ground: two broad flat ice slabs topped with snow
map: an overhead distant snowy tundra map with blue glacier ridges, small fir groves, dark frozen streams and open snow paths, subtle green aurora glow, no animals
